tasks.intent: The checkout team reports that totals no longer reconcile with the ledger. Move the billing package to integer minor units (cents), stop the module-level cache from accumulating across calls, and keep the report format the ledger expects.

The circulation desk reports that fine totals no longer reconcile with the ledger. Move the loans package to integer minor units (cents), stop the module-level cache from accumulating across calls, and keep the report format the ledger expects.

Support reports that box-office totals disagree with the finance export. Move the ticketing package to integer minor units (cents), stop the module-level cache from accumulating across calls, and make the report and the CSV export agree with the same money contract.

Finance reports that payslip totals disagree with the ledger export. Move the payroll package to integer minor units (cents), stop the module-level cache from accumulating across calls, and make the report and the CSV export agree with the same money contract.

Warehouse auditors found stock totals that drift between the report, the CSV export and the audit trail. Move the inventory package to integer minor units (cents), remove the process-wide caches and the ledger that grows across calls, stop evaluating discount expressions with eval, and make every consumer agree with one money contract.

Depot auditors found mileage totals that drift between the report, the CSV export and the audit trail. Move the fleet package to integer minor units (cents), remove the process-wide caches and the ledger that grows across calls, stop evaluating discount expressions with eval, and make every consumer agree with one money contract.
